 print('cell', [o.GetCellData().GetArrayName(i) for i in range(o.GetCellData().GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY"

item.text:
Done. The rendered Morse–Smale segmentation is here:

[fracture_morse_smale.png](/workspace/fracture_morse_smale.png)

I also saved the reproducible ParaView state and script:

[fracture_morse_smale.pvsm](/workspace/fracture_morse_smale.pvsm)  
[render_fracture_msc.py](/workspace/render_fracture_msc.py)

Used persistence simplification threshold 0.05. The result has 15 minima (blue), 22 saddles (white), and 8 maxima (red), all rendered as radius-2 spheres.
